dct_description_sm: The Geospatial Portal is the online gateway for the GNWT and the public to discover and access the geographical data stored by the GNWT in the Spatial Data Warehouse. Through this website, you can search for data layers of interest, query them, and display them on a map. You can use the mapping tools to create your own customized maps of the NWT with the data layers of interest, query them, and display them on a map. The purpose of the GNWT Spatial Data Warehouse is to provide access to NWT data in one convenient location for the GNWT and public. Use the links on the left to navigate the site. The Search all the data in the site link will open the Metadata Explorer which you can use to find the data you need. The Create Web Maps link will open the Internet Map Framework pages to view online dynamic maps. This site requires its own login so you may need to create an account there. The NWT Centre for Geomatics runs the GNWT Spatial Data Warehouse under the direction of the GNWT Interdepartmental Geomatics Steering Committee. IGSC Terms of Reference. It is a service funded by the Departments of Education, Culture and Employment; Environment and Natural Resources; Industry, Tourism and Investment; Municipal and Community Affairs; and Transportation. GNWT Geospatial Portal news this page will list items of significance related to this portal. Upcoming events this page will list items of general interest to Geomatics users in the NWT.
dct_title_s: Government of Northwest Territories (GNWT) Spatial Data Warehouse - Geospatial Portal
